# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/thrr87/skille/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

Include only the minimum information needed to reproduce the problem. Never
attach credentials, private skill contents, local paths, sidecar data, raw
agent output, or screenshots containing private information.

Security fixes are applied to the current `main` branch. This project does not
currently publish supported releases.
